description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format.

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- feature: add dark mode toggle (#12)
- bug: fix crash on empty note (#15)
- docs: update install guide (#20)
- refactor: split parser module (#22)
- feature: export notes as PDF (#30)
- bug: handle unicode titles (#31)
evals.expected_output: Six lines in the format '- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)', grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, with input order kept inside each group (FEAT 12 then 30, FIX 15 then 31, DOCS 20, CHORE 22).

evals.name: Bullet without an issue number gets (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- feature: add search filter (#40)
- bug: fix typo in settings label
evals.expected_output: Two lines: '- [FEAT] Add search filter (#40)' then '- [FIX] Fix typo in settings label (#none)'.
